name: muse-code-desktop
description: Unofficial desktop command center for Muse Code

scripts.dev: npm run build:bridge && npm run tauri -w muse-code-desktop -- dev
scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run tauri -w muse-code-desktop -- build
scripts.preview: npm run build:bridge && npm run preview -w muse-code-desktop
scripts.verify: npm run check:versions && npm run typecheck -w @muse/bridge && npm run typecheck -w muse-code-desktop && npm test && npm run test:ui && node scripts/check-a11y.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run build:bridge && npm run build -w muse-code-desktop && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
